A.why: Radiating gold sunburst crest plus wide pale-stone slab pauldrons over dark old bronze: one strong idea, reads at ARPG distance, distinct from every reference family.
A.fix: Age and thicken the sunburst (fewer broad bronze-gold rays, not plumage); cover the bright avatar green at the thighs; simplify the toothy waist fringe.

B.why: Stone dome pauldrons are a good idea but too small and read lopsided from above; cool grey-green drifts toward fenscale.
B.fix: Double and equalise the domes, seat them on the shoulder; warm the green to brown bronze; give the back something.

C.why: Barrel pauldrons with gold boss caps read as two clear circles and give mass, but the mid-green base sits near fenscale and the cross crest reads cleric.
C.fix: Shift metal to brown old bronze with verdigris as accent; replace the cross crest with a sun or stone crest.

D.why: Pale stone slab pauldrons and stone helm read well, but the lime/grass green is saturated and toy-like, not aged bronze, and collides with fenscale.
D.fix: Replace the green with dark olive-brown bronze; give the helm a real crest instead of the leaf sprig.

E.why: Pale sage plate with pale stone is low contrast and washes toward linen from above; the small ridge crest is the only shape idea.
E.fix: Commit to one big silhouette (tall fan crest or stepped statue pauldrons) and darken the metal so stone and gold separate.

F.why: Right muted olive-bronze and pale stone, big back sun-wheel visible from above; but the wheel reads as a gear and the front box helm echoes iron.
F.fix: Turn the cog teeth into rays; carry a sun motif to the front (chest disc or helm crest); warm the grey stone.

notes: Judged from sheet.png and sheet-A..F only. A is the only candidate whose one idea (sunburst crest) carries the set at the ARPG camera. A and F have the right aged olive-bronze; B, C, D, E all lean too green (D lime, E pastel) and risk fenscale. Every candidate leaves bright avatar green showing at the thighs, which is the loudest colour from above: worth a shared fix. Ideas worth borrowing: C's barrel pauldrons, F's back sun-wheel (as rays, not a cog).
